title: Klimakatalog — a curated catalog of GenesisAeon climate science packages
description: Curated catalog of 46+ GenesisAeon climate-science packages (P17-P128), each with its own real, citable abstract, DOIs, and domain-theme tags (atmosphere, ocean, cryosphere, biosphere, hydrology, carbon cycle, society, extremes). Additionally exposes a semantic map: clusters and cross-cluster relationships compiled only from connections explicitly documented in a package's own abstract or README -- not from thematic similarity or automated matching. Machine-readable via /llms.txt and /context.json. Does not itself perform any climate modeling; it is a navigation layer over independently published packages. Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem.
